original_frontmatter.description: Custom GLSL vertex and fragment shaders: uniforms, varyings, shader chunks, extending built-in materials, instanced attributes, plus the same effects as node materials with TSL on WebGPU. Use when writing a shader, a custom material or effect, moving vertices in a shader, or porting GLSL to TSL.
